name: Timeline
summary: Chronological sequence of events. Vertical (default) or horizontal. Each item carries a marker (dot, icon, or thumbnail), a timestamp, an actor, an event summary, and optional body. Three densities. Used for audit logs, activity feeds, deployment histories, order tracking.

items.description: Array of TimelineItem descriptors. Each: { id, marker?, time, actor?, title, body?, tone? }.

showConnector.description: Render the connector line between markers.

keyboard: Tab - move focus across interactive items
rules: Each TimelineItem is a <li> with a clear time element (<time datetime=ISO>).
Markers are decorative (aria-hidden) — the meaning comes from the textual content.
When the timeline streams, append-only updates announce via aria-live='polite'.

do: Lead each item with WHEN, then WHO, then WHAT: '2 m ago · Avery Mercer · approved invoice #1284'.
Render <time datetime=ISO> so the timestamp is machine-readable + tooltip-able.
Use status tones (success / warning / danger / info) on the marker for at-a-glance scan.
Compact density on operator audit logs; comfortable on user-facing activity feeds.
dont: Don't render Timeline without a stable sort — chronological order is the affordance.
Don't paint every marker in lime — only success / approval markers use text.accent.
Don't omit the connector line — it's the visual cue that ties events together.
